# SKOS

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Simple Knowledge Organization System - a W3C standard data model, expressed in RDF, for representing controlled vocabularies such as thesauri, taxonomies, and classification schemes.

## Scope note

The core standard underpinning this vocabulary and the SKOS Editor tool itself; concepts, schemes, and relationships here are all expressed using SKOS.
